result.description: EmberDock is a fictional rack-style network archive appliance designed for archival data vaults and studio asset libraries. It supports 12TB of mirrored capacity across two removable 6TB cartridges, connects over dual 10GbE, and includes basic snapshot scheduling and write-once retention modes. The unit is positioned for small teams that need quiet long-term storage rather than gaming or workstation acceleration.
result.title: Nebula Forge EmberDock 12TB Network Archive Pod
result.title_description: Network archive pod with dual-cartridge 12TB mirrored storage
